text: Advertisements for unhealthy food and drinks should be banned. Discuss this view. [30]
Assess the view that it is easier to write non-fiction than fiction. [30]
‘Politicians have become poor role models.’ To what extent do you agree? [30]
Gene editing can only be beneficial to humanity. Discuss this view. [30]
To what extent does a good education system make a country successful? [30]
Large business corporations are a threat to global security. Discuss this view. [30]
Evaluate the importance of marriage in today’s world. [30]
Email is an inadequate method of communication. Discuss. [30]
Evaluate the extent to which international cooperation is vital for ensuring that everyone has access
to clean water. [30]
‘Music is created purely for pleasure and has no intended meaning for its listeners.’ Discuss. [30]
